# package store

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-canopen/store"
```

Package store keeps the parameters of a CANopen device across restarts: the persistence behind the store parameters (0x1010) and restore default parameters (0x1011) objects of CiA 301.

A [Store](#type-store) saves and loads a list of values (index, sub-index, encoded value). [Memory](#type-memory) keeps it in memory (a restart of the device in the same process); [File](#type-file) keeps it in a file, as a concise DCF (package cdcf), replaced atomically on every save. The node package (option node.WithStore) implements the objects on top of a Store:

  - writing the signature "save" (SignatureSave) to 0x1010 sub-index 1 (all parameters), 2 (communication, 0x1000..0x1FFF), 3 (application, 0x6000..0x9FFF) or 4 (manufacturer, 0x2000..0x5FFF) saves the current values of the parameters of that group;
  - writing "load" (SignatureLoad) to the same sub-index of 0x1011 deletes the saved values of the group, so that the defaults apply from the next reset on;
  - at its creation and at each NMT reset the node restores the defaults of the areas the reset concerns and then loads the saved values of those areas.

[AddObjects](#func-addobjects) adds 0x1010, 0x1011 and the verify configuration object 0x1020 to a dictionary.

## Constants

```go
const (
	// IndexStore is the store parameters object (ARRAY of UNSIGNED32).
	IndexStore uint16 = 0x1010
	// IndexRestore is the restore default parameters object (ARRAY of
	// UNSIGNED32).
	IndexRestore uint16 = 0x1011
	// IndexVerifyConfiguration is the verify configuration object
	// (RECORD: sub-index 1 configuration date, 2 configuration time),
	// written by a configuration tool or manager with the configuration
	// and compared by a CiA 302 manager with its expected values
	// (0x1F26, 0x1F27).
	IndexVerifyConfiguration uint16 = 0x1020
)
```

Objects of CiA 301 this package is about.

```go
const (
	SignatureSave uint32 = 0x65766173
	SignatureLoad uint32 = 0x64616F6C
)
```

Signatures written to 0x1010 and 0x1011 (CiA 301): the ASCII codes of "save" and "load" as an UNSIGNED32, least significant byte first.

```go
const (
	All           uint8 = 1 // all parameters (0x1000..0x9FFF)
	Communication uint8 = 2 // communication parameters (0x1000..0x1FFF)
	Application   uint8 = 3 // standardised profile parameters (0x6000..0x9FFF)
	Manufacturer  uint8 = 4 // manufacturer-specific parameters (0x2000..0x5FFF)
)
```

Sub-indices of 0x1010 and 0x1011 (CiA 301), each a group of parameters.

## Functions

### func AddObjects

```go
func AddObjects(d *od.Dictionary) error
```

AddObjects adds to d, where missing, the store parameters (0x1010) and restore default parameters (0x1011) objects with sub-indices 1..4 (UNSIGNED32, rw) and the verify configuration object 0x1020 (sub-index 1 configuration date, 2 configuration time, UNSIGNED32, rw).

### func Apply

```go
func Apply(d *od.Dictionary, entries []cdcf.Entry, first, last uint16) error
```

Apply sets the entries in \[first, last] into d locally (no access check or hooks; watchers see the changes) and returns the entries it could not set (an object the dictionary no longer has, a value of the wrong size), joined in the error.

### func Excluded

```go
func Excluded(index uint16) bool
```

Excluded reports objects that are never saved although writable: 0x1010 and 0x1011 themselves, the program download objects 0x1F50 (program data) and 0x1F51 (program control), and the manager's requests 0x1F82 (request NMT) and 0x1F83 (request node guarding), which are commands, not parameters.

### func Merge

```go
func Merge(saved, current []cdcf.Entry, first, last uint16) []cdcf.Entry
```

Merge returns saved with the entries in \[first, last] replaced by current (which should only hold entries in that range).

### func Parameter

```go
func Parameter(v *od.Variable) bool
```

Parameter reports whether a sub-object is a parameter that is saved: access rw (not the process data of rww and rwr objects, not read-only, constant or write-only), and not [Excluded](#func-excluded).

### func Range

```go
func Range(group uint8) (first, last uint16, ok bool)
```

Range returns the index range of a group (sub-index 1..4 of 0x1010 and 0x1011); ok is false for other sub-indices (manufacturer-specific groups, which CiA 301 leaves to the device).

### func Snapshot

```go
func Snapshot(d *od.Dictionary, first, last uint16) []cdcf.Entry
```

Snapshot returns the current values of the parameters ([Parameter](#func-parameter)) of d with an index in \[first, last], in index order.

### func Without

```go
func Without(entries []cdcf.Entry, first, last uint16) []cdcf.Entry
```

Without returns the entries outside \[first, last].

## Types

### type File

```go
type File struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

File is a [Store](#type-store) in a file holding a concise DCF. Save writes a temporary file in the same directory, syncs it and renames it over the file, so that the file always holds a complete set of values. A missing file is an empty store. File is safe for concurrent use within one process.

#### func NewFile

```go
func NewFile(path string) *File
```

NewFile returns a store kept in the file at path.

#### func (File) Load

```go
func (f *File) Load() ([]cdcf.Entry, error)
```

Load implements [Store](#type-store).

#### func (File) Path

```go
func (f *File) Path() string
```

Path returns the file's path.

#### func (File) Save

```go
func (f *File) Save(entries []cdcf.Entry) error
```

Save implements [Store](#type-store).

### type Memory

```go
type Memory struct {
	// contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```

Memory is a [Store](#type-store) in memory, safe for concurrent use. Its zero value is empty.

#### func NewMemory

```go
func NewMemory() *Memory
```

NewMemory returns an empty in-memory store.


#### func (Memory) Save

```go

```

Save implements [Store](#type-store).

#### func (Memory) Saves

```go

```

### type Store

```go
type Store interface {
	// Load returns the saved values (none when nothing was saved).
	Load() ([]cdcf.Entry, error)

}
```
